body.en: *Advertising* is an impersonal form of communication paid for by an identified sponsor to promote ideas, goods or services, through media such as television, newspapers, radio, outdoor hoardings and the internet. Features: paid, impersonal, identified sponsor, mass reach. Merits: reaches a large audience, low cost per person reached, enhances customer satisfaction and confidence, and is expressive. Limitations: less forceful than a personal talk, lack of feedback, inflexibility and relatively wasteful. Objections raised include higher costs, undermining social values, confusing buyers, encouraging inferior products and being in bad taste; supporters reply that advertising lowers costs per unit through larger sales and gives information.

points.en: Mass reach at low cost per person

body.en: *Personal selling* is the oral presentation of a product in a conversation with one or more prospective buyers to make a sale. It is personal, two-way, flexible and builds relationships, and is especially useful for costly, technical or new products. A good salesperson has physical qualities (good health, pleasant manner), psychological qualities (tact, patience, empathy, initiative), product and customer knowledge, communication skills and honesty. Compared with advertising, it is more forceful and gives immediate feedback, but it reaches fewer people at a much higher cost per contact.

points.en: Best for costly, technical, new products
More forceful but costly per contact

Buy two shirts, get one free
An insurance agent explaining a policy to a family
A lucky draw with every purchase this week

explanation.en: Advertising is paid mass communication; personal selling is face to face; sales promotion offers short-term incentives.

say.en: Sort each activity.

problem.en: Why is personal selling preferred for selling industrial machinery?

steps.en: The product is technical and costly; buyers need explanations and demonstrations.
Buyers have questions that need immediate answers (two-way communication).
The number of buyers is small, so the high cost per contact is affordable.
Long-term relationships and after-sales service matter.

answer.en: Technical, costly products with few buyers need personal, two-way persuasion.
